text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, that reminded me of my days in 
the theater troupe...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...One day, the applause after a 
performance was pretty sparse, you see—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...My acting wasn't able to move anyone."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was just like that time... I 
couldn't entertain anyone at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... moping around won't get me 
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My dream... my "miracle" is still only 
halfway there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Did you not hear the cheers?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I heard it loud and clear! 
The voices calling out to me...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"As long as there's even one person 
waiting for me, I'll keep running to the 
ends of the earth!!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...! You're such a reliable 
partner!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I will engrave today's defeat into my 
heart...! I'll reset my mindset and start 
anew!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win and deliver 
inspiration to everyone!
